description: Modelled, not measured: a listed GPU-hour rate divided by the output throughput NVIDIA published for that card and model, per million output tokens, at the cheapest live on-demand rate card and at the median, with NVIDIA's run (model, framework, precision, sequence, concurrency, date). Cards are not comparable on it - NVIDIA runs each card differently - and an idle GPU costs the same and produces nothing: a floor, never a bill.

gpu.description: GPU id or name; NVIDIA publishes runs for B200, B300, H100 SXM, H200 and RTX PRO 6000.

model.description: Optional model name to keep (gpt-oss-120b, "Qwen 3.5"); default every model NVIDIA ran on the card.

name: token_cost

cite_as.description: How to cite this answer: GPU Economy, the page, the data date.

title: Cost per million output tokens (modelled)
